```sql
WITH lap_records AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuitId,
        c.name AS circuit_name,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        r.year,
        r.name AS race_name,
        lt.time AS lap_time,
        lt.milliseconds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.circuitId ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC) AS rn
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
)
SELECT
    circuit_name,
    driver_name,
    year,
    race_name,
    lap_time,
    milliseconds
FROM lap_records
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY circuit_name;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
  split_goals(match_id, rest) AS (
    SELECT id, goal
    FROM Match
    WHERE goal IS NOT NULL AND goal LIKE '%<player1>%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id,
           substr(rest, instr(rest, '</player1>') + 11)
    FROM split_goals
    WHERE instr(rest, '<player1>') > 0
  ),
  player_goals AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CAST(
             substr(
               rest,
               instr(rest, '<player1>') + 9,
               instr(rest, '</player1>') - (instr(rest, '<player1>') + 9)
             ) AS INTEGER
           ) AS player_api_id
    FROM split_goals
    WHERE instr(rest, '<player1>') > 0
  )
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM player_goals pg
JOIN Match m ON m.id = pg.match_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pg.player_api_id
WHERE pg.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
         SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, substr(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
  FROM yearly
  GROUP BY Segment
),
increases AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (Cons2013 - Cons2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(Cons2012, 0) AS PctIncrease
  FROM pivoted
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease
FROM increases
WHERE PctIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PctIncrease) FROM increases)
   OR PctIncrease = (SELECT MIN(PctIncrease) FROM increases)
ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC;
```
